description: Repository provenance inventory: every tracked file or directory that is not original Clockgrove work (reused, vendored, third-party-licensed or generated from a third-party source), with its source, license and reason. Clockgrove's own work is MIT (LICENSE). pnpm check refuses an entry whose path is not in the checkout or that lacks a source, license or reason.

dependencies.note: Third-party npm dependencies are inventoried from pnpm-lock.yaml, with their licenses checked against the allowlist, in the CycloneDX SBOM that the producer writes; they are not repeated here.

entries.part: the block between <!-- BEGIN:turborepo-agent-rules --> and <!-- END:turborepo-agent-rules -->
entries.reason: turbo writes and re-adds this agent guidance block before repository-scoped commands when it detects an AI agent; it stays committed so those runs leave no uncommitted change.
